PositionText.description: One repo's position in a record.

commit.description: 40 lower-case hex, or `null` for a directory with no commit.

tree.description: The hash of uncommitted changes (64 lower-case hex), or `null` when the checkout is clean.

facts_version.description: The facts version the graph was built under (extractor ids, salts and profile hashes).

graph_digest.description: SHA-256 of the canonical graph export, lower-case hex.

positions.description: One entry per repo with a root here, sorted by repo.
